name: Alistair Campbell
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent glued to the TV, watching legendary Kiwi drivers like Bruce McLaren and Denny Hulme. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, he started his career in the pit lane, analyzing telemetry data for a smaller racing team. His analytical skills quickly shone through, leading him to a strategist role where he excels at identifying opportunities and mitigating risks during races. While Alistair thrives on collaboration, he is also known for his independent thinking and willingness to challenge conventional wisdom. 

Having spent several seasons in various motorsport categories, Alistair brings a wealth of experience to Joe Gibbs Racing. His approach to strategy blends data-driven analysis with an intuitive understanding of race dynamics. He is particularly adept at forecasting tire degradation and anticipating competitor strategies, giving his team a crucial edge on the track. He sets himself apart with his innovative strategies, and meticulous attention to detail, making him a valuable asset in the high-pressure environment of top-tier racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly weathered face and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'The Art of War' in his briefcase.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Earl Grey tea before every race.
